optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Operations Process Specialist, Collaboration Software Subscriptions

professionalSummary.text: Operationalized renewal processing for business subscriptions with seat-count verification against admin console exports, reducing manual corrections through proactive measures.
professionalSummary.witness: Processed monthly and annual renewals for business subscriptions in the billing system, checking seat counts against the customer's admin console export before each invoice run. After I introduced the pre-invoice seat check, manual corrections dropped from about one in five renewals to almost none.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained billing-correction checklist and correction-cause list (seat-count drift, expired purchase orders, currency mismatch), adding pre-invoice seat check after correction wave.
experienceHighlights.witness: Maintained the billing-correction checklist and the running list of correction causes (seat-count drift, expired purchase orders, currency mismatch), adding a pre-invoice seat check after a wave of seat-count corrections.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated disputed invoices with finance and customer success via dispute queue, with finance controller approval for credit notes above limit.
experienceHighlights.witness: Handled disputed invoices with finance and customer success through the dispute queue; credit notes above the agreed limit were approved by the finance controller.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared quarter-end hand-over notes listing open disputes, corrections in progress, and unresolved causes for subscription operations lead.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the quarter-end hand-over note for the subscription operations lead, listing open disputes, corrections in progress and the causes still unresolved.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Billing-correction checklist with pre-invoice seat check and correction-cause list for one quarter, verified by billing system case numbers.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the billing-correction checklist with the pre-invoice seat check and the correction-cause list for one quarter, with the billing system's case numbers as a verification trail.

skills.text: Billing system operations, dispute resolution, quarterly hand-over documentation, correction cause analysis.
skills.witness: Responsibilities included renewal processing, checklist maintenance, dispute handling and quarter-end hand-over for the subscription operations team over roughly two years.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's direct experience with renewal processing, checklist maintenance, dispute coordination, and quarter-end hand-over. The claim about reducing manual corrections from 'one in five' to 'almost none' is supported by a cover email but lacks documented evidence or source figures.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required due to unsupported claim about correction rate reduction and missing documentation for quarterly baseline reporting.
